The mission stats, the two hero personas (THE CLIENT / THE ARCHITECT) and the four principles are already seeded as scoped blocks — but principles 02 and 03 and the architect persona's second bullet were rewritten when the design moved from an escrow marketplace to an introductions platform, and seeds/content_blocks.json still re-seeds the old wording, so they are restored here. copy.text: A licensed architect, matched to your jurisdiction

principles.title: We set expectations in the open
principles.body: An itemized typical range from real inputs — size, scope, and jurisdiction complexity — before the first conversation. Architects set their own price from there.

principles.title: We take nothing from the build
principles.body: You hire and pay your architect directly, at their rate — no escrow, no cut of the project. Our revenue is the architect’s flat subscription.

personas.title: You, free to do the work you trained for
personas.points:
Receive pre-scoped clients — no cold bidding
Set your rate; clients hire and pay you directly
Practice anywhere you’re licensed, entirely remotely
